content: Hello! How can I assist you with your account today?
Hi, I forgot my password and need to reset it to log in.
No problem. Please go to the login page and click on the 'Forgot Password?' link below the sign-in fields.
I see the link. Should I click it now?
Yes, please click it. When prompted, enter your registered email address.
Okay, I entered my email and it says a verification code was sent.
Great! Check your inbox for the code. Once you have it, enter the code on the website to proceed.
I just entered the code. Now it wants me to create a new password.
Perfect. Create a strong new password, confirm it, and then click 'Submit' to complete the reset.
Done. I'm able to log in now. Thank you for your help!
